business_summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited, a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals. The company operates through three segments: Precision Medicine, Therapeutics, and Manufacturing Solutions. Its lead therapeutic product candidate is TLX591, a lutetium-labeled radio antibody-drug conjugate (rADC), which is in a Phase 3 clinical trial in patients with advanced prostate cancer. The company develops TLX250, an rADC for treating advanced metastatic kidney cancer; TLX101, a systemic therapy for the treatment of glioblastoma; TLX66, a product candidate for bone marrow conditioning for hematopoietic stem cell transplant conditioning; and Illuccix and Gozellix for the treatment of prostate cancer. The company is also developing TLX592, a prostate cancer therapy candidate for targeted alpha therapy based on its proprietary RADmAb-engineered antibody technology; TLX252 for the treatment of patients with advanced metastatic kidney cancer; TLX400, a bladder fibroblast activation protein for treating various tumors; TLX102, a large amino acid transporter-targeting small molecule-based alpha therapy candidate for the treatment of glioblastoma and multiple myeloma; TLX300 for treating soft tissue sarcoma; and TLX090, a bone-seeking agent for bone metastases and pain palliation. In addition, it is developing BiPASS, which is in Phase 3 clinical trial for prostate cancer diagnosis; AlFluor, a novel PET radiochemistry solution; TLX250-Px, a PET diagnostic imaging agent; and TLX101-Px, a radiolabeled amino acid PET agent. It operates in Australia, Belgium, Canada, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. The company has strategic collaboration with University Hospital Essen. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in North Melbourne, Australia.
business_summary_ko: 상업 단계의 바이오제약 회사인 Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited는 치료 및 진단용 방사성 의약품의 개발 및 상용화에 중점을 두고 있습니다. 이 회사는 정밀 의학, 치료제, 제조 솔루션이라는 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 주요 치료제 후보는 루테튬 표지 방사성항체-약물 결합체(rADC)인 TLX591로 진행성 전립선암 환자를 대상으로 3상 임상시험이 진행 중이다. 회사는 진행성 전이성 신장암 치료를 위한 rADC인 TLX250을 개발합니다. 교모세포종 치료를 위한 전신치료제 TLX101; 조혈모세포 이식 조건화를 위한 골수 조건화 제품 후보인 TLX66; 전립선암 치료를 위한 Illuccix 및 Gozellix. 이 회사는 또한 독자적인 RADmAb 공학 항체 기술을 기반으로 표적 알파 요법을 위한 전립선암 치료제 후보인 TLX592를 개발하고 있습니다. 진행성 전이성 신장암 환자 치료를 위한 TLX252; 다양한 종양 치료를 위한 방광 섬유아세포 활성화 단백질인 TLX400; 거대 아미노산 수송체를 표적으로 하는 소분자 기반 알파치료제 'TLX102'
